title: Research emotion in context: human and AI perspectives on the affective landscape of Severance
core_idea: The study investigates how emotions are represented and perceived in the television series Severance by applying a multi-layered, scene-by-scene annotation framework based on Parrott's hierarchical taxonomy across all nine episodes of season 1, creating four datasets (human text-only, human multimodal, and two LLM outputs) and comparing them to examine modality effects, inter-annotator agreement, and temporal and character-based emotion patterns.
tldr: Compare human and LLM emotion annotations of Severance (season 1) using a Parrott-based, multimodal scene-level corpus to study how modality and character dynamics shape emotional representation.
